name: Sigiriya
shortDescription: Ancient rock fortress, village landscapes and one of Sri Lanka’s most memorable cultural stops.
description: Sigiriya is at the heart of Sri Lanka’s Cultural Triangle. Its iconic rock fortress, surrounding countryside and easy access to heritage sites make it a rewarding base for a private journey.

name: Kandy
shortDescription: Sri Lanka’s cultural capital, known for the Temple of the Tooth, lake and surrounding hills.
description: Kandy combines living Buddhist culture, colonial-era streets and green hills. It makes a natural stop between the Cultural Triangle and tea country.

name: Nuwara Eliya
shortDescription: Cool highland air, tea estates and misty views on Sri Lanka’s scenic central plateau.
description: Nuwara Eliya’s tea-covered hills and cooler climate provide a relaxed pause on a journey through the central highlands.

seo.title: Nuwara Eliya Private Tours | Chauffeur Emil

name: Ella
shortDescription: A relaxed hill-country base for train journeys, viewpoints, tea country and short walks.

name: Galle
shortDescription: A historic fort, stylish streets and easy access to Sri Lanka’s southern beaches.
